merge_meta.description: Merge stage of a decompose-then-merge pipeline: seven per-document maps of Finland's general housing allowance (yleinen asumistuki) process merged into one map. No source documents were read; only the seven per-document maps.
merge_meta.input_note: outputs/perdoc_sonnet_law-938-2014.json was rewritten by another process (mtime 09:21:50) after the first read: the first version had 108 nodes / 152 edges, the version merged here has 90 nodes / 131 edges (sha256 above). All other six maps were unchanged.
rules_applied: R1 same unit of work across maps -> one merged node, all evidence quotes kept with their source file names (compound input nodes that cover two units are split by quote: see 'evidence_used' in merge_log)
R2 every input node is accounted for in merge_log; no node was added that no map contains

R3 every input edge is kept (mapped to merged nodes, duplicates collapsed, conditions joined with ' | ') except the order conflicts listed in edges_dropped (law > guidance pages > form); self-loops created by merging are not kept

R4 confidence: 2 distinct source documents = 0.90, +0.02 for each further document (max 0.97); one document = the input confidence capped at 0.89 (inputs at 0.70 or above are steps that stay in 0.70-0.89; inputs below 0.70 are inferred/rule-only support and stay below 0.70)

R5 actor: if the maps disagree between kela_system and kela_caseworker the merged node is kela_caseworker (no quote says a step is automatic) and the disagreement is noted at the end of the description; the guide's single actor 'kela' does not distinguish and abstains; kela_customer_service was mapped to kela_caseworker, household_member to citizen; citizen-vs-system disagreements (VIEW, ABSENCE) were resolved to the performing citizen and noted
R6 merge_log lists, for each merged node, the input node ids and map files it came from
merge_meta.type_rule: node type follows the resolved actor (system_task <-> caseworker_task); automation_class and agent_mode are taken from the highest-priority (law, guide, English page, Finnish page, income page, PTV, form) input node whose actor equals the resolved actor
